bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money to celebrate 50 years of Southeast Asians in Minnesota.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; CELEBRATING 50 YEARS OF SOUTHEAST ASIANS IN MINNESOTA. +]

[+$....... in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to Visit Saint Paul to provide subgrants to organizations representing Minnesota's Southeast Asian communities for events celebrating the 50-year presence of Southeast Asian communities in this state. A subgrant under this section may be made only to an organization that: +]

[+(1) provides a ten percent match for the subgrant; and +]

[+(2) will use the subgrant for events between May 1, 2025, and December 31, 2025. A grant may be awarded to a subgrantee under this section to reimburse the subgrantee for events occurring between May 1, 2025, and June 30, 2025. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money to celebrate 50 years of Southeast Asians in Minnesota.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; CELEBRATING 50 YEARS OF SOUTHEAST ASIANS IN MINNESOTA.

$....... in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to Visit Saint Paul to provide subgrants to organizations representing Minnesota's Southeast Asian communities for events celebrating the 50-year presence of Southeast Asian communities in this state. A subgrant under this section may be made only to an organization that:

(1) provides a ten percent match for the subgrant; and

(2) will use the subgrant for events between May 1, 2025, and December 31, 2025. A grant may be awarded to a subgrantee under this section to reimburse the subgrantee for events occurring between May 1, 2025, and June 30, 2025.
